text:
talia: Heads-up for folks flying out for the offsite: SFO has a new sleep pod area in Terminal A. Anyone tried them? Worth the $20/hour for a 2h power nap? 
greg: Took one in Feb. Very worth it if you're on a red-eye. Small, quiet, decent mattress, but bring your own eye mask/earplugs. Wi-Fi is meh.
hiro: How private are they? Could you actually nap without being woken up for boarding?
pat: They lock from inside for the session but staff will knock if the gate calls. Pro tip: set a loud alarm on your watch + gate alert in the airline app.
lounge-bot: Sleep pod details: Terminal A level 3, 12 pods, lockers available. https://airport.example/sleep-pods (check hours).
talia: Also curious about lounges: is it worth a $50 day-pass for coffee + quiet before check-in? Im between options: coffee in terminal vs lounge nap + snacks.
greg: If you need outlets and a quiet table to knock out slides or email before the offsite, lounge > food court. Free coffee, protein snacks, comfy chairs. But lines during peak = meh.
hiro: If youre on a budget, find the smaller airline lounges (less packed) or bring a travel mug and sit in the quieter gate areas near windows.
pat: Anyone want to swap podcasts while waiting? I'm currently obsessed with "Tiny Histories" and need new recs for the flight.
talia: Ooh: "Sleepy" and "LeVar Burton Reads" for calming, and "How I Built This" for pre-offsite inspiration.
greg: For productivity: "Deep Work" episodes + a white-noise track. For laughs: "Conan O'Brien Needs A Friend".
hiro: I'll trade you a curated 90-min "ambient focus" playlist for a Tiny Histories episode. DM me.
lounge-bot: Quick reminder: if you plan lounge/pod time, add it to the travel spreadsheet so others know gate/ETA. Link in travel-planning pinned.
talia: Follow-up q: anyone ever had luggage left in a pod or lounge? Slightly paranoid.
greg: Once left a backpack on a pod chair. Lounge staff held it at the desk for 30 min. Don't leave valuables unattended.
pat: PSA: mark your bag with a bright ribbon for quick ID at carousel. Also stash a small laminated card with contact info inside the bag.
talia: Thanks all. Booking a pod for 90 mins and maybe a lounge pass. If anyone wants to meet near Gate A7 for a pre-boarding game of "two truths" before the offsite, I'm down.
hiro: Count me in. Also bringing extra earplugs to share. :ear_plugs: 
pat: Love it. See you all at the gate — and thanks for the podcast recs.
lounge-bot: Noted: talia reserved pod (A3) 90m. Shared note added to travel checklist.
